sourcePolicy.zh: 以官方档案、博物馆与专业历史词典核对时期内容；Wikipedia/Wikidata 在本批次主要用于实体与词条对应。保留原始属性与时期主题参考的区别。
sourcePolicy.en: Period content is checked against public archives, museums and specialist historical dictionaries. Wikipedia/Wikidata principally support topic identity in this batch. Original source identity and curated period references remain separate.
